similarityReview: The model captures the iconic double-helix twisted geometry of the Tao Zhu Yin Yuan tower. The central core is represented by a tall cylinder, with stacked floor plates modeled as polygonal prisms that rotate slightly to create the twist. The glass facade and greenery-filled balconies are represented by layered box and prism components. The top structure is modeled with a central core and surrounding roof canopy elements.
